title: UAG’s new bags can help your devices recover from an unexpected dunking.
summary: Not every gadget is waterproof, so Urban Armor Gear partnered with Dryout for a new collection of bags, pouches, and backpacks featuring pockets with absorbent liners that pull moisture away from drowned devices.
